title: ISIS weaponizes $2,000 quadcopters in Mosul
detail: SOCOM commander called armed ISIS drones the most daunting problem of 2016; 70+ drones over 24 hours nearly stalled the Mosul offensive. Triggered the first US joint urgent C-UAS buys.

title: Army JUON buys SRC LIDS ($65M)
detail: First large US counter-drone system of systems; the root of FS-LIDS/E-LIDS.

title: Navy HELIOS laser ($150M) to Lockheed
detail: First US Navy ship-integrated HEL with a counter-UAS mission.

title: Preventing Emerging Threats Act (6 U.S.C. 124n)
detail: Gave DHS and DOJ authority to detect, disrupt, seize and destroy threatening drones notwithstanding wiretap and aircraft-sabotage laws.

title: Gatwick shutdown
detail: ~1,000 flights and 140,000 passengers disrupted by drone sightings; became the global case study for airport C-UAS.

title: Army named DoD Executive Agent for C-sUAS; JCO stood up (Feb 2020)
detail: Created the Joint Counter-small UAS Office to unify doctrine, requirements, materiel and training.

title: JCO picks interim C-sUAS systems
detail: ~40 fielded systems cut to an approved set: FS-LIDS, NINJA, CORIAN, L-MADIS, Bal Chatri, Drone Buster, Smart Shooter, FAAD-C2.

title: DoD Counter-sUAS Strategy published
detail: First department-wide C-sUAS strategy.

title: Anduril wins SOCOM CUxS integrator IDIQ ($967M → $1.92B)
detail: A venture-backed newcomer becomes SOCOM's counter-unmanned systems integrator.

title: Russia invades Ukraine — mass drone war begins
detail: Shahed/Geran campaigns rose from ~200 to ~1,100 launches per week (Sept 2024 to Mar 2025); interceptor drones emerged as the cost-effective answer.

title: Army picks Epirus Leonidas HPM ($66.1M)
detail: High-power microwave beat six rivals for IFPC-HPM.

title: 17 days of drone incursions over Langley AFB
detail: Some F-22s relocated; the source was never identified — the case that put homeland base defense on the agenda.

title: Tower 22: drone kills 3 US soldiers in Jordan
detail: An Iran-backed militia one-way drone arrived alongside a returning US drone and was not engaged; 47 injured.

title: Replicator 2 = counter-small UAS
detail: SecDef Austin made installation C-sUAS the second Replicator line of effort.

title: USMC I-CsUAS program of record to Anduril ($642M)
detail: 10-year installation C-UAS for Marine bases worldwide.

title: India–Pakistan drone battle (Operation Sindoor)
detail: Led to India's $231.6M emergency C-UAS procurement.

title: Operation Spiderweb
detail: Ukraine launched 117 FPV drones from trucks inside Russia and hit up to 41 strategic bombers — the template for an attack on US bases from inside the perimeter.

title: EO 14305 'Restoring American Airspace Sovereignty'
detail: Created the Federal Task Force to Restore American Airspace Sovereignty (chaired by the NSA) and directed the FBI C-UAS training center.

title: OBBBA funds $500M FEMA C-UAS grants
detail: One Big Beautiful Bill Act Sec. 90005(a): $500M over two years to SLTT.

title: Hegseth creates JIATF-401 (replaces JCO)
detail: Army-led task force with authority to approve up to $50M per initiative; reports to the DepSecWar.

title: Russian drones enter Poland; NATO shoots them down
detail: ~23 drones; Article 4 invoked; NATO launched Eastern Sentry. Denmark airport and air-base incursions followed in late September.

title: Coyote $5.04B contract to Raytheon
detail: Largest LIDS award to date (through 2033).

title: SAFER SKIES Act enacted (FY26 NDAA)
detail: C-UAS authority extended to trained state and local police and corrections.

title: FEMA awards $250M to World Cup states + NCR
detail: Fastest non-disaster grant in FEMA history.

title: First Replicator 2 buy: Fortem DroneHunter (net capture)
detail: Picked because capture minimizes collateral damage at home.

title: C-UAS Marketplace reaches IOC
detail: 1,600+ items listed by March; public cuas.mil launch in August.

title: Operation Epic Fury (US/Israel vs Iran)
detail: Army bought 13,000 Merops in 8 days and shipped 10,000 to the Middle East; NORTHCOM jammed a drone over a 'strategic' US base in the first hours.

title: Anduril $20B Army C-UAS enterprise vehicle
detail: Largest C-UAS contract vehicle ever published; Lattice designated as the C-UAS C2.

title: FIFA World Cup 2026 begins (to July 19)
detail: 300+ drones taken down across venues; FAA TFRs of 3 nm / 3,000 ft.

title: SLTT C-UAS rule effective; DRPM-UxS created
detail: DOJ/DHS IFR expects an RF-only first technology list; Hegseth creates the Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager for Unmanned Systems over JIATF-401 and DAWG.

title: DHS $1.5B department-wide C-UAS IDIQ
detail: 12 companies across products and services tracks.

title: JIATF-401 $7B Marketplace IDIQ wave
detail: $4.15B to 10 vendors; >$5B awarded in total; more by end of October 2026.

title: Counter-drone laser triggers El Paso airspace shutdown
detail: A laser fired near Fort Bliss without FAA coordination closed El Paso airspace for 7+ hours; on 27 Feb a laser downed a CBP drone. Domestic directed energy meets the FAA.

title: First AMP-HEL laser engagements of cartel drones on the border
detail: JTF-SB engaged three cartel-linked drones with the AMP-HEL laser. DoW reported 378 cartel drones detected from Aug 22 to late Sep 2026 (via Fox News).
